summary.text: SLEMDALSVEIEN 70 AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1972-06-19. It was previously named STORM EIENDOM AS until 2024-06-28. Its registered activity: "Utleie av fast eiendom." Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 23 971 071 NOK and the annual result was 3 204 252 NOK; operating income was up from 21 757 375 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 2 011 421 NOK in 2024 to 3 204 252 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 9 786 145 NOK in 2024 to 9 314 283 NOK in 2025. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (254900NU8N3UP2Y19867). The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-25 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
